Acidic solution $A$ ine $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ uye solution $B$ ine $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Kangani kuwanda kwehydrogen ion mu $A$ kwakakura kudarika $B$?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.prompt: [E6 Ongororo yeKemesitiri (Pamberi)] Dambudziko rekuongorora huwandu nezve Acid neBase. Acidic solution $A$ ine $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ uye solution $B$ ine $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Kangani kuwanda kwehydrogen ion mu $A$ kwakakura kudarika $B$?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.explain:
Danho 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Danho 2: Ratio $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
Danho 3: Huwandu hwa $A$ hwakakura zvakapetwa ka100 kudarika $B$.
